显式当前AST方法 5，目标AST方法 6（typed synthesized负span构造器不作为源码施工对象）；真实typed caller 8，callee 170。参数/返回/表达式/所在行均在card_data；反射/XML/native入口须以domain或专门入口证据补足，零typed caller不能伪称dead code。

| 合约 | 原文证据值 |
|---|---|
| owner | CertificateBundleService policy; fixed window statistics are inputs |
| thread | Certificate research executor; statistics preparation off writer |
| transaction | Pure evaluate; existing publish owner writes only validated current policy result |
| trigger | Completed original prospective pairs at declared endpoint |
| idempotency | policy + frozen lifetime + window/endpoint + full evidence hash |
| failure | Missing gate/NaN/gap/identity mismatch => no certificate |
| recovery | New legitimate evidence only; no rewrite past predictions or label outcomes |
| test | CertificateMathReferenceTest and source-bound required-gates/identity regressions |

## 真实调用与运行合约

显式当前AST方法 0，目标AST方法 38（typed synthesized负span构造器不作为源码施工对象）；真实typed caller 182，callee 318。参数/返回/表达式/所在行均在card_data；反射/XML/native入口须以domain或专门入口证据补足，零typed caller不能伪称dead code。

引用检测 `本文件未获CSV直接关联`；需求 `HIST-E05D-01, HIST-E05D-02, HIST-E05D-03, HIST-U04-02, HIST-U04-06, USR-41-002, USR-41-003`。完整原CSV行、根因、测试、验收和来源行号在source_traceability。

| transaction | readonly frozen snapshot; outputs spool files not business tables |
| trigger | Service FULL ctx ->export ->96runner results/member plan |

## 真实调用与运行合约

显式当前AST方法 0，目标AST方法 15（typed synthesized负span构造器不作为源码施工对象）；真实typed caller 74，callee 34。参数/返回/表达式/所在行均在card_data；反射/XML/native入口须以domain或专门入口证据补足，零typed caller不能伪称dead code。

引用检测 `本文件未获CSV直接关联`；需求 `本文件未获CSV直接关联`。完整原CSV行、根因、测试、验收和来源行号在source_traceability。

| 合约 | 原文证据值 |
|---|---|
| owner | One process-wide algorithm memory partition |
| thread | Synchronized reservation reads/acquires on worker caller |
| transaction | No DB mutation |
| trigger | Model/Atom/Matrix prepare acquires bounded lease |
| idempotency | Lease instance and reserved byte counter |
| failure | Insufficient budget => RESOURCE_YIELD without allocation |
| recovery | Close lease exactly once in finally; clear recomputable caches only |
| test | Lowheap recipe/model/Atom tests and budget close/overlap regression |
| acceptance | Shared model/Atom partition, no per-prediction full-budget creation, no forced GC loop |
